hypotheses.reasoning: Trigger: redis-cache restarted after a node replacement at 13:03:17 with no RDB snapshot, so it started empty (#157). search-api's cache miss ratio jumped to 97% (baseline 5%), then 94% (#158, #163), so nearly every /search lookup fell through to catalog-db as single-row SELECTs on products. catalog-db then hit 490/500 connections (439 active) with CPU at 99% (#162), and per-query latency rose from normal to 3-8s (#164, later #191, #195, #226, #235). search-api product queries began timing out at 5000ms (#171), and web-bff returned 504s after 10-25s (#172). Before 13:03 the system was healthy; catalog-db, index-worker and the v3.9.2 deploy (#64, #67) show no fault. The DB and gateway errors are downstream of the cache miss storm, which the cold cache amplified.

verdict.recommendedAction: Restore redis-cache capacity and warm it: restore from the last snapshot, or pre-warm the hot product keys from catalog-db before sending full traffic. Enable RDB persistence on redis-cache so a node replacement doesn't start empty. Protect catalog-db short term with request coalescing or a rate limit on cache-miss loads. Watch catalog-db connections and CPU until the miss ratio returns to baseline (~5%).
